# Pinewood Grid Services - procedure register

The register was issued with the procedure rewrite and the prefixes are fixed for the life of a procedure; rows are kept in alphabetical order of the procedure name. Last reviewed 2026-01-22, reference PRC-1188.

turns.prompt: Pinewood Grid Services is configuring the intake queue for access review requests and has to enter the prefix those tickets carry. Which prefix is it?
